observations: Photo 0 shows five alternators lying on a concrete floor, with visible signs of wear, rust, and dirt. One alternator in the top center has a black plastic cover with a ribbed design and a visible pulley. The others show varying degrees of corrosion and damage.

Photo 1 shows four alternators from a top-down view, focusing on the rear housing. The black plastic covers have ventilation slots and mounting points. One alternator in the bottom right has a green sticker or label on the center cap.
No brand or model markings are visible on any of the alternators in either photo.
The alternators appear to be used, with some showing rust on the metal housing and mounting brackets.
The seller's text claims these are '2GR' alternators for 2008 Highlander, Sienna, RX350, Avalon, Rav4, Venza, Camry v6, ES350 — but no visual evidence confirms this.

claims.claim: Alternator 2GR for 2008 Highlander, Sienna, RX350, Avalon, Rav4, Venza, Camry v6, ES350.
claims.evidence: No part numbers, brand, or model markings are visible in the photos. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: The alternator may not be compatible with the claimed vehicle models.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number or label on the alternator, or a photo showing the alternator installed on a 2008 Highlander or similar vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or for general use only

risks.risk: The alternator may be damaged or non-functional due to visible rust and wear.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components (brushes, rotor, stator) or a video showing it spinning and producing voltage.

risks.risk: The alternator may be counterfeit or not genuine 2GR part.
risks.proof: A photo of the original packaging or a label with a genuine Toyota part number.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any part numbers, labels, or markings on the alternators.
A video or photo showing the alternator spinning and producing voltage (if functional).
Photos of the alternator installed on a 2008 Highlander or similar vehicle to confirm fitment.
response.reason: The alternators are visible but lack any readable brand or model identifiers. The seller's claim about compatibility with 2008 Toyota models cannot be verified from the photos. Without proof of model, condition, and functionality, a price cannot be determined. The item must be priced at its worst case until proven otherwise.
